answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The pearl is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the shale. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. By the relic of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
